title: [Bug Fix] #177: IRS 1099 orphan fields on Purchase Order/Cr. Memo pages
summary: IRS 1099 fields on Purchase Order and Purchase Credit Memo pages now correctly appear inside the Invoice Details FastTab instead of as orphaned fields outside it.
key_points: Changed page extension anchoring from addafter to addlast for proper group placement
Fields now render inside Invoice Details FastTab consistently with Purchase Invoice extension
Visual layout fix resolves rendering of controls outside their intended container
No behavioral or data logic changes
Affects both Purchase Order and Purchase Credit Memo IRS 1099 extensions
quote: The three IRS 1099 fields on the Purchase Order (and Purchase Credit Memo) pages rendered as orphan fields outside any FastTab.
